description: This file defines a static class StorageEmulator that provides utility methods to interact with the Azure Storage Emulator, including starting, stopping, checking if it is running, and retrieving help information. It manages process detection and execution of emulator commands.

classes.name: StorageEmulator
classes.description: A static utility class providing methods to control and query the Azure Storage Emulator process.

methods.name: IsStarted
methods.description: Checks if the storage emulator process is currently running.

methods.name: Exists
methods.description: Determines if the storage emulator is installed by checking for its executable path.

methods.name: Help
methods.description: Retrieves help information from the storage emulator process.

methods.name: TryStart
methods.description: Attempts to start the storage emulator if it exists.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the storage emulator process if it is not already running.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the storage emulator process if it is running.

methods.name: CreateProcessArguments
methods.description: Creates a ProcessStartInfo configured to run a specific command for the emulator.

methods.name: GetStorageEmulatorProcess
methods.description: Checks system processes to determine if the emulator is running.

methods.name: GetStorageEmulatorPath
methods.description: Locates the storage emulator executable path based on known installation directories.

methods.name: GetProgramFilesBasePath
methods.description: Returns the base path for Program Files depending on OS architecture.
